# FastGPTPlus

> > Comprehensive guides for accessing ChatGPT Plus, Gemini Pro, and AI APIs from China and restricted regions with payment solutions and technical tutorials.

FastGPTPlus provides detailed technical documentation and payment guides for Chinese users accessing OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude APIs. The site specializes in virtual credit card solutions, regional pricing strategies, VPN configurations, and developer integration tutorials for AI services.

## Key Topics

- ChatGPT Plus subscription and payment methods
- Virtual credit card solutions (WildCard, Depay)
- Gemini API and ChatGPT API comparison
- China and Hong Kong access solutions
- iOS App Store payment methods
- API integration and rate limiting
- Regional pricing strategies
- VPN and proxy configurations
- Developer tools and CLI integration
- Payment declined troubleshooting
- Cost analysis and pricing comparison
- OCR and image upload features
- Claude API access methods
- ChatGPT Pro upgrade paths
